scope_events.reason: T-001/T-002 need three paths the prompt's write set did not enumerate and no sibling agent claims: frontend/src/lib/api/explore.ts (nothing can open a session without a client for POST /api/explore/sessions), frontend/src/store/index.ts (FR-001's reload persistence is gated by the partialize whitelist, which keeps file tabs only), and frontend/src/store/tabSlice.parts/** (syncActiveTab must treat an Explore tab like a preview tab or the backing workflow tab loses its snapshot). Reported to the manager in the final report.
